name: Uptime.com
summary: Uptime.com sells one Website Monitoring plan in quantity tiers, from $84 a year for 10 basic checks, 1 advanced check and 25 SMS alerts. Every tier checks once a minute and includes unlimited users, and status pages are an add-on.

evidence.capability: http and ping checks from many locations

facts.text: An alert fires when the number of probe servers reporting a check as down reaches the sensitivity the user sets.
Uptime.com's status page reported an IPv6 connectivity problem across several probe locations from September 29, 2026 that may cause false down alerts, with IPv4 checks unaffected.
In 2025 Uptime.com replaced its Starter, Essential and Premium tiers with the current tiered plan.
Uptime.com hosts its main application on AWS in the United States.
The pricing FAQ offers a 30-day money-back guarantee to new users, while the terms say paid fees are non-refundable.

plans.name: 10 basic checks
plans.notes: $9 on monthly billing. 1 advanced check and 25 SMS alerts

plans.name: 50 basic checks
plans.notes: $38 on monthly billing. 5 advanced checks and 75 SMS alerts

plans.name: 100 basic checks
plans.notes: $75 on monthly billing. 10 advanced checks and 100 SMS alerts

plans.name: 1,000 basic checks
plans.notes: $750 on monthly billing. 100 advanced checks and 1,500 SMS alerts

hiddenCosts: Status pages are an add-on; the pricing page's calculator data lists one page at $13 a month or $120 a year.
Each SMS and phone call counts against the tier's monthly allowance, and more requires the next tier.

contract.cancellation: The terms say paid fees are non-refundable and that orders are renewed by paying renewal fees.
contract.dataExport: SLA reports as PDF or XLS, and uptime statistics through the API.
